answer: No single credential proves personhood, so our registry pairs every new agent with a bonded sponsor whose stake is slashed whenever its recruit is caught coordinating with a cluster of look-alike accounts. A newcomer starts as a jetty: narrow, throttled, allowed only limited traffic until it completes several epochs of independently verifiable work. Reputation then rises with the tide of attestations from unrelated peers, while a ring of clones that only vouch for one another gains nothing and can wander into decay, since its weight fades unless fresh external peers keep confirming it.
